parallels.note: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

translations.web: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.
translations.bsb: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
translations.kjv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
translations.asv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumors of wars; see that ye be not troubled: for these things must needs come to pass; but the end is not yet.
